sources.note: 54 raw labels, prior fitted/gated models unchanged; no archive download or refit
National and point records overlap; never sum as independent events. Native status/message lifecycle and actual polygon or provider point-filter provenance are retained.
Actual backend-selected coordinates; four explicit forecast windows plus latest available station readings, not universal 50-site weather coverage

Parameter 63160 historical/provisional stage sample, not latest-live guarantee. Datum and basin/site transfer absent; rejected as site water evidence. Legacy WaterServices retirement is February 22, 2027 per official notice; new acquisition uses api.waterdata.usgs.gov/ogcapi/v1.
Real automatic Pakistan grid, real model estimate at hypothetical source location; zero US EIA-site coverage. Uncertainty product and damage labels absent.
Only K-index message families mapped to geomagnetic context. No structured expiry inferred from prose; no current site warning or outage estimate.
Actual read-only backend selector export, source hash/state/plant/coordinates checked; no deployed DB contents or active work orders verified.
Prior receipts/limitations retained. NIFC sample is attributes only; no new perimeter geometry, containment, historical issued cohort or basin transfer.
MAP_KEY/archive access not supplied. Existing detector parser and synthetic hotspot/perimeter scenario are not authenticated collection.
Account/API key not supplied. Concentration units and explicit averaging windows remain distinct from AQI.
Separate historical regulatory archive; no AQS adapter/records claimed and not used as live AirNow.
No new mapped background raster/soil/coastal issuance histories. NRI is long-term background, not a current event. Synthetic drought/tsunami contexts do not establish collection.
No universal or authenticated regional API acquired. Reviewed-notice contracts and fixtures only; no scraping/auth bypass.
Server-owned issuer/role/time/site review gates; no actual reports, sensor measurements, identities or production writes collected.
